query: INSERT INTO businesses.emergency_switch (member_id, business_id, switch_on) SELECT id, business_id, $3 FROM businesses.team_member WHERE id = $1 AND business_id = $2 AND removed_at IS NULL ON CONFLICT (member_id) DO UPDATE SET switch_on = $3, yes_at = CASE WHEN $3 THEN businesses.emergency_switch.yes_at END, test_sent_at = CASE WHEN $3 THEN businesses.emergency_switch.test_sent_at END
